description: Search RateMDs by name/keyword, specialty, or scrape specific doctor profiles.

doctorSlug.description: The doctor slug or full URL from RateMDs (mode=doctorProfile). Example: 'dr-john-smith-new-york-ny-us' or full URL.
doctorSlug.title: Doctor slug / URL

includeReviews.description: Fetch the most recent reviews from each doctor's profile page. Adds one extra HTTP request per doctor.
includeReviews.title: Include recent reviews

location.description: City name or city-state to filter results (e.g. 'New York', 'Los Angeles', 'Toronto'). Works with mode=search and mode=bySpecialty.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of doctor records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: Scrape list of doctor profile URLs
mode.title: Mode

profileUrls.description: List of RateMDs doctor profile URLs to scrape. E.g. 'https://www.ratemds.com/doctor-ratings/dr-john-smith-new-york-ny-us/'.
profileUrls.title: Doctor profile URLs (mode=byUrl)

searchQuery.description: Doctor name, keyword, or medical condition to search for (mode=search).
searchQuery.title: Search query

title: RateMDs Doctor Scraper Input
